## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, `.env` files, model files, or generated caches are included.
- [ ] Tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization remain enforced.
- [ ] Migrations and rollback impact are documented, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog impact are addressed.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and unrelated files are not included.
